description: Estimates annual/monthly US property tax from a home value and either a custom rate or a state's real 2026 effective property tax rate. Example: { homeValue: 350000, stateCode: "NJ" }. Estimate for guidance — 2026 rates from official sources (IRS/Tax Foundation/CRA/ATO/state revenue offices/HMRC).

assessmentRatioPct.description: Percent of market value actually assessed (default 100; some states assess less than market value).

exemption.description: Homestead exemption amount in USD, subtracted from the assessed value.

homeValue.description: Market value of the home in USD.

ratePct.description: Optional custom effective property tax rate (%). Overrides the state's rate if both are given.

stateCode.description: Optional two-letter state code. When provided (and ratePct is not), the state's real 2026 effective property tax rate is used automatically.

name: us_property_tax
title: US property tax
